meta.method: walk-london-datastore.mjs harvest census2021-ward-demography-migration: 11 resources (xlsx); a row is kept when a cell holds a zone code of type ward2026 or ward2018 or ward2014 (feeds/london-datastore/zone-codes.json: areas that meet the 3D model box or hold a zone postcode). Ward tables give the City of London as one row (E09000001), kept as a zone row. Sheets: the up to 3 rows above the first coded row are kept as header_rows. CSV: streamed; the first line is the header; a row is kept by its first E00/E01/E02/E05 code.
